mapper.select: SELECT seq, collection, id, owner_id, data, updated_at FROM documents WHERE collection = #{collection} AND id = #{id}
SELECT seq, collection, id, owner_id, data, updated_at FROM documents WHERE collection = #{collection} ORDER BY seq
SELECT seq, collection, id, owner_id, data, updated_at FROM documents WHERE collection = #{collection} ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO documents (collection, id, owner_id, data, updated_at) VALUES (#{collection}, #{id}, #{ownerId}, #{data,typeHandler=com.tabletop.persistence.FastjsonMapTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM documents WHERE collection = #{collection} AND id = #{id}
